hookups.source: https://www.milehighcampground.com/campsites ('Please note: No hook ups, no electricity.') + https://www.milehighcampground.com/about ('We are still a primitive campground (hot showers, limited internet, no site electricity nor water)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 50 sites besides two host sites, counting the group site: 35 list a camper/motorhome space of 24 ft or more (13 at 24 ft, 1 at 25, 7 at 30, 14 at '30+'), 5 take 20 ft, 2 are 'Tent or Camper Van' and 8 tent-only. Lengths are the operator's 'approximate camper/motorhome space'.

values.note: 'Season: May 15 - October 15, exact dates may vary.'

season.source: https://www.milehighcampground.com/reservations ('Season: May 15 - October 15 , exact dates may vary.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations by phone (828-269-2945) for the current and next season, taken May 1 - October 15. Non-refundable deposit of one night (two for view sites and holiday bookings). 'Two night minimum stay for all view sites and holiday bookings.'

note: Primitive ridgetop campground (~5,400 ft) on Cherokee land leased from the Eastern Band, one mile up Heintooga Spur Rd from the Blue Ridge Parkway (MP 458); many sites have long mountain views. Generators 9 am-6 pm, two hours at most. Tight maneuvering uphill; a 23-ft rig is workable but not roomy. --Claude
summary: Confirmed no hookups, hot showers, camp store, and the $35 site rate (two adults) on the operator's pages; added season May 15-Oct 15 ('exact dates may vary'), phone reservations with a 2-night minimum on view sites and holidays, and 50 sites (35 with 24-ft+ rig space). Access: NPS lists Parkway MP 455.7-469.1 and the Heintooga Spur Road open; the operator's pages give no road, 4WD or rig-length warning, and its events page lists 2025 events (site maintained). Google Maps: 4.6 / 308 reviews, phone matches. Flush toilets and potable water left as derived (pages say 'clean bathrooms' and 'toilet houses' only). Note: dropped hookup/facility/season restatements, added the generator rule.
flags: Rate date: the $35 site rate is on the live reservations page but undated (Squarespace; the about page reads as written c. 2019, the events page lists 2025 events). Under US$50 either way, and Great Smoky Mountains NP is 11 km away.
